creative_direction.name: Washed Linen Morning Column
creative_direction.brief: 晨光里的亚麻幕：水洗亚麻布自墙面垂落并铺成连续同料地面，折痕在真实基准线处没入布面，柔和窗光把织纹照成细暖的颗粒；商品立于布地偏右，接触阴影陷进织纹，宽蝴蝶结两侧保留完整横向呼吸。左半幅布面保持安静，承载一根 Times 竖排文字柱：品牌字居柱顶，题名以窄柱大字排印如裁缝签条，一条麻色细线竖于两栏之间如缝线。垂直方向与瓶肩重叠、水平方向宽距分离，双栏编辑网格诚实成立；织物的哑光与玻璃凹槽的高光互为粗细。
creative_direction.material: washed linen cloth cyclorama sweeping from hanging drape into continuous linen ground
creative_direction.lighting: soft diffuse morning window light, gentle frontal with faint weave grain glow, no hard shadows, matching the baked studio light

background.prompt: Washed natural linen cloth in warm honey oat tone hanging as a soft drape wall and sweeping into a continuous matching linen ground at a horizontal horizon six tenths down the frame, gentle cloth creases and fine weave grain, soft diffuse warm morning light, even illumination, no objects
